caption: The drawing features several views of a cylindrical mechanical object. At the center left, there is a large depiction of a vertical cylinder with a removable upper section; the top part has a perforated surface, while the bottom half appears solid and slightly wider, supporting the object on a round base. To the right of this, there is a perspective view of the closed cylinder, which is plain and uniform with a circular top and bottom, each having a series of small, evenly spaced round protrusions along the edges. There are three inset diagrams in the upper right and lower left corners: each shows a technical elevation view of the cylinder with dimensions provided, indicating a height of 5½ inches and a diameter (at different points) around 1⅜ inches and 1 inch. The drawing is rendered in pencil with careful shading and linework on beige paper, and includes measurement notations, technical labels, and a small signature "Michael Fénon" at the bottom right. The overall composition is arranged within a square border, and the objects are all shaded in grayscale without any additional color.
title: Silver Nutmeg Grater
